task.description: ISS-0093 is MINOR severity but the fix (re-enabling triggers previously disabled across six tables) has broad blast radius on the integration test suite. Confirm no NFR or release-blocking regression before sign-off.

result.summary: Independently verified: branch touches only tests/integration/helpers.zig (shim removal) and audit_iss103_test.zig (cleanup helper fix), plus new ISS-0094/ISS-0095 registry filings and handoff bookkeeping -- confirmed via git diff main...HEAD --stat run directly, not copied from the TEST-RUNNER report. Spot-checked obs05_dlq_test.zig source: confirmed missing api_tenant_context.set() as claimed. Verified ISS-0090 (RESOLVED, MINOR) genuinely predates this branch (first observed 2026-07-30) and corroborates the aggregate-contention failure class at comparable magnitude (~109-120 vs 93 here). Found and corrected one report-quality defect: TEST-RUNNER report miscited ISS-0092 (an unrelated memory-leak issue) as corroborating category_c; does not affect the verdict since ISS-0090 alone already supports it. Checked the one plausible mechanism specific to this diff -- newly-enabled triggers on six tables adding lock contention -- against category_c symptom details; none of the deadlock/FK failures implicate those six tables. Zero of 134 failing cases attributed to the ISS-0093 change. Verdict: RELEASE.
